items.text: This table has a single confirmed process updating it, running daily since 2016. All 5,645 rows come from that same process, with no competing candidate and no placeholder records

The full path this data takes has been traced end to end. It comes from an external system, a SQL Server database used for HQ analytics, is staged temporarily, then combined with the vendor list already in this warehouse. The same external connection has now been confirmed as the source for a second cross reference table in this project, which makes it increasingly likely, though still not proven, that the main vendor table also comes from that same external system
No invalid vendor keys and no duplicate vendor and cost-zone combinations were found

blocks.text: Still open, not confirmed in code or data yet. None of this blocks the lineage above, it is tracked here so nothing gets forgotten.

items.text: It is increasingly likely, but still not directly confirmed, that the main vendor table is fed by the same external HQ analytics system confirmed here and on one other cross reference table
items.note: Confirming this would resolve one of the most frequently repeated open questions in this project; it should be confirmed directly with the Weis team rather than inferred further
